11.1 大语言模型的后训练: 对齐与推理
Large Language Models (LLMs): Post-Training: Alignment and Reasoning

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0

Deep Learning for NLP — Large Language Models (LLMs) — Post-Training: Alignment and Reasoning

Learning goals

  • understand supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and instruction tuning
  • understand preference learning with reward models, PPO, and DPO
  • understand behavioral trade-offs such as reward hacking and over-refusal
  • learn about chain-of-thought reasoning

目标: 理解有监督微调 (SFT) 和指令微调; 理解用奖励模型、PPO 和 DPO 做偏好学习; 理解奖励投机 (reward hacking) 和过度拒答这类行为上的权衡; 了解思维链推理. 这份课件把 9.1–9.3 节 (指令微调、RLHF) 和 9.5 节 (DeepSeek 推理) 的内容重新组织成一条线: 预训练 → SFT → 偏好优化 → 推理.

预训练得不到助手
Pretraining does not produce an assistant · From pretraining to post-training

Slide 1–2

A pretrained language model learns to predict the next token: pθ​(xt​∣x<t​)

  • It learns language, knowledge, and many useful capabilities.
  • But it is not explicitly trained to follow a user’s instruction.
  • Given a prompt, it may continue the text rather than answer the request.
Prompt
Explain the moon landing to a 6 year old in a few sentences.
Completion
GPT-3
Explain the theory of gravity to a 6 year old.

Explain the theory of relativity to a 6 year old in a few sentences.

Explain the big bang theory to a 6 year old.

Explain evolution to a 6 year old.

OpenAI, 2022

Predicting text is not the same objective as being a useful assistant.

After pretraining, additional training is used to shape model behavior.

Pretrained LM ⟶ SFT ⟶ Preference / RL training ⟶ Assistant

  • SFT: learn from examples of desired responses.
  • Preference optimization: learn which responses are preferred.
  • Reasoning and safety can also be shaped during post-training.

Post-training changes how the capabilities learned during pretraining are used.

预训练的语言模型学的是预测下一个词元 pθ​(xt​∣x<t​): 它学到了语言、知识和很多有用的能力, 但没有被明确地训练去听从用户的指令; 给它一个提示, 它可能只是把文字续写下去, 而不是回答请求. 例子: 提示「用几句话给 6 岁小孩讲讲登月」, GPT-3 的续写是另外几条类似的指令 (「给 6 岁小孩讲讲引力理论」……), 因为在网页文本里, 一条这样的指令后面最常见的就是一串类似的指令 (比如一份习题清单). 预测文本和做一个有用的助手不是同一个目标.

预训练之后再做额外的训练来塑造行为: 预训练模型 → SFT (从期望回答的例子学) → 偏好 / 强化学习训练 (学哪些回答更受偏好) → 助手; 推理能力和安全性也可以在后训练中塑造. 后训练改变的是预训练学到的能力如何被使用, 并不主要增加新知识.

有监督微调 (SFT)
What is supervised fine-tuning? · SFT uses the language-model objective · Which tokens contribute to the SFT loss?

Slide 4–6

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains the pretrained model on instruction–response pairs. (x,y)= (instruction / context, desired response)

For example:

User:Explain why the sky is blue.
Assistant:Sunlight is scattered by molecules in the atmosphere …
  • The desired response is provided by humans or another model.
  • The model parameters are updated.
  • This is therefore training, not prompting.

The model is still trained by next-token prediction. For instruction x and desired response y=(y1​,…,yT​):

LSFT​=−t=1∑T​logpθ​(yt​∣x,y<t​).
  • The architecture does not need to change.
  • What changes is the training data.
  • Instead of arbitrary web text, the model sees examples of the behavior we want.

Same prediction objective, different data distribution.

A training sequence contains both a user prompt and an assistant response.

<user> Explain why the sky is blue. </user>
<assistant> Sunlight is scattered ...</assistant>

Typically, prompt tokens (context) | assistant tokens (prediction targets)

  • The prompt is given to the model as context.
  • The loss is typically computed on the assistant response.
  • The model learns which response should follow a given instruction.

SFT 用「指令 (上下文) – 期望回答」对来训练预训练模型. 期望回答由人或另一个模型提供; 模型参数会被更新, 所以这是训练, 不是提示. 目标函数仍然是预测下一个词元: 在给定指令 x 和前面已有的回答词元 y<t​ 的条件下, 最大化回答中每个词元的对数概率. 结构不变, 变的只是训练数据: 不再是任意的网页文本, 而是我们想要的行为的例子. 目标相同, 数据分布不同.

一条训练序列同时包含用户提示和助手回答. 提示只作为上下文输入, 损失通常只在助手回答的词元上计算 (提示部分的标签设成 −100 之类的忽略值, 见练习单合集 Exercise 03). 这样模型学的是「给定指令后应该接什么回答」, 而不是去学预测用户会怎么提问.

SFT 数据从哪里来; FLAN
Where does SFT data come from? · FLAN: an early example of instruction tuning · How does FLAN fine-tuning work? · Instruction tuning generalizes to new tasks

Slide 7–10

In InstructGPT, SFT examples were built from prompts and human-written demonstrations.

Prompt ⟶ Human writes a good response ⟶ SFT example

  • Prompts were largely drawn from the distribution of real user requests.
  • Initially, annotators also wrote prompts to bootstrap the dataset.
  • The main challenge is obtaining high-quality desired responses.

Ouyang et al., 2022: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

FLAN (Fine-tuned LAnguage Net) fine-tunes a pretrained language model on many tasks written as natural-language instructions.

  • Tasks are converted into prompted natural-language formats.
  • One model is trained across many different tasks.

Wei et al., 2021: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners

  • Each task is represented through natural-language instructions.
  • The model is fine-tuned jointly on many such tasks.
  • At test time, it can be given an instruction for a task that was not used directly for training.

A central result of FLAN is improved performance on held-out tasks.

  • The evaluation tasks were not included in the fine-tuning mixture.
  • The instruction tells the model what task to perform.
  • Instruction tuning therefore improves zero-shot task generalization.

InstructGPT 的 SFT 数据: 先有提示, 再由人写一个好的回答. 提示大多来自真实用户在 API 上的请求; 一开始没有用户数据时, 标注员也自己写提示来启动. 主要难点是得到高质量的期望回答 (要请受过训练的人逐条写).

FLAN (Fine-tuned LAnguage Net) 是指令微调的早期例子: 把许多现成的 NLP 任务改写成自然语言指令的形式, 用同一个模型在所有这些任务上一起微调. 读图 (Slide 8): A 是 BERT/T5 式的「预训练–微调」, 每个任务一个专门的模型, 需要大量任务数据; B 是 GPT-3 式的提示, 不更新参数, 用少样本例子或提示工程; C 是指令微调: 在很多任务 (B、C、D……) 上微调, 学会「按自然语言指令做事」, 再去做没训练过的任务 A. 读图 (Slide 9): 训练任务里有常识推理 (「想在夏天睡得凉快, 该把枕套放冰箱还是烤箱?」)、翻译、情感分析、共指消解等; 测试时给一个从没训练过的任务类型, 自然语言推理 (前提「到我这个年纪, 你大概已经学过一课」能否推出假设「不确定你三十多岁能学到多少课」), 模型答「无法判断」.

核心结果是在留出的任务上表现提高: 评估任务没有出现在微调数据里, 指令告诉模型要做什么, 所以指令微调提高了零样本泛化能力. 读图 (Slide 10): 在三类未见任务上, FLAN 137B 的零样本 (蓝) 都超过 GPT-3 175B 的零样本 (橙), 自然语言推理 (56.2 对 42.9) 和阅读理解 (77.4 对 72.6) 甚至超过 GPT-3 的少样本 (红).

SFT 不容易规定什么
What can SFT not easily specify?

Slide 11

Suppose several responses to the same prompt are all plausible.

Response AResponse B
plausible answeranother plausible answer
  • Writing the single “ideal” response can be difficult or ill-defined.
  • Many desirable properties are hard to express through one target sequence.
  • It may be much easier for a human to answer:

Which response is better?

This motivates preference learning.

同一个提示往往有多个都说得过去的回答. 写出唯一的「理想」回答可能很难, 甚至没有定义; 很多想要的性质 (语气、详略、谨慎程度) 很难用一个目标序列表达. 但让人判断「哪个回答更好」要容易得多. 这就引出偏好学习.

RLHF 的起源: 学后空翻
Motivation: backflipping · Origin of RLHF: learn how to backflip

Slide 13–14
  • What a backflip is: [Link: backflip]
  • How to teach a backflip?

How to label data for training a backflipper?

  • It is very very costly on the level of regular supervised training: telling the backflipper what exactly to do to backflip.
  • Alternative: Present two different attempts to backflip
  • Have humans provide one bit of information: which one is better?
  • This animation shows what we want to learn: [Link: trained backflipper]
  • Human chooses one of two clips = one bit: [Link: example of human feedback]
  • Trained backflipper: [Link: trained backflipper]

RLHF 起源于机器人控制 (Christiano et al. 2017): 怎么教一个模拟机器人做后空翻? 按普通有监督学习的方式标注, 要告诉它每一刻每个关节该怎么动, 代价极高. 替代办法: 给人看两次后空翻的尝试, 让人只提供一比特信息: 哪个更好. 用大量这样的比较训练一个奖励模型, 再用强化学习优化策略, 机器人最终学会了后空翻. 9.2 节讲过同一个例子.

偏好数据; 「更好」是什么意思
Preference data · What does “better” mean? · Learning from preferences

Slide 15–17

Instead of asking humans to write the ideal response, we can ask them to compare model-generated responses. For a prompt x, suppose a human prefers y+ over y−: (x,y+,y−).

  • Several responses can be generated for the same prompt.
  • Human labelers rank the responses by quality.

(Screenshot der InstructGPT-Annotationsoberfläche: mehrere Modellantworten werden per Drag-and-drop von „best“ bis „worst“ sortiert. Ouyang et al., 2022: InstructGPT)

In InstructGPT, labelers were asked to prefer responses that are helpful, truthful, and harmless.

But these objectives can conflict.

  • A very helpful answer may contain incorrect information.
  • A harmless answer may refuse a request that could have been answered safely.
  • Different people may disagree about which response is preferable.

Preference labels encode judgments about desired model behavior.

The original InstructGPT pipeline has three training stages:

  • SFT. Training data: human-written responses.
  • Reward model. Training data: human rankings of model-generated responses.
  • Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Optimization signal: trained reward model.

不让人去写理想回答, 而让人比较模型生成的回答: 对提示 x, 人更偏好 y+ 而不是 y−, 得到三元组 (x,y+,y−). 同一个提示可以生成多个回答, 标注员按质量排序. InstructGPT 要求标注员偏好有帮助、真实、无害 (helpful, truthful, harmless) 的回答. 但这些目标会冲突: 非常有帮助的回答可能包含错误信息; 无害的回答可能拒绝一个本可以安全回答的请求; 不同的人对哪个更好也会有分歧. 偏好标签编码的是对模型应有行为的判断.

读图: InstructGPT 的三步. 第 1 步: 从提示库抽一个提示 (「给 6 岁小孩讲讲登月」), 标注员写出期望的回答, 用这些数据对 GPT-3 做有监督微调. 第 2 步: 对一个提示让模型生成几个回答 (A–D), 标注员从好到坏排序, 用排序训练奖励模型 (RM). 第 3 步: 抽一个新提示 (「写一个关于青蛙的故事」), 策略模型生成回答, 奖励模型给它打分, 用这个奖励通过 PPO 更新策略. 三步的训练数据分别是: 人写的回答、人对模型回答的排序、训练好的奖励模型给出的信号.

奖励模型
What is a reward model? · Learning the reward model from preferences · What has the reward model learned?

Slide 18–20

A reward model assigns a scalar score to a prompt–response pair: rθ​(x,y)∈R.

prompt x + response y ⟶ reward model ⟶ score rθ​(x,y)

  • Higher reward should correspond to responses humans prefer.
  • θ denotes the parameters of the reward model.
  • In InstructGPT, the reward model is trained from human-ranked model outputs.
  • Same architecture as the SFT model, but smaller: InstructGPT used a 6B reward model when the policy had 175B parameters.

(Unten auf der Folie steht die Verlustformel der nächsten Folie noch einmal.)

Suppose the labeler prefers yw​ over yl​. We want rθ​(x,yw​)>rθ​(x,yl​). In InstructGPT, the reward-model loss is

loss(θ)=−(2K​)1​E(x,yw​,yl​)∼D​[logσ(rθ​(x,yw​)−rθ​(x,yl​))].
  • x: prompt.
  • yw​: preferred (winning) response.
  • yl​: lower-ranked response.
  • D: fixed dataset of human preference comparisons.
  • A ranking of K responses yields (2K​) pairwise comparisons.

The reward model does not directly learn truth, safety, or usefulness. It learns to predict the preferences represented in its training data: rθ​(x,y)≈ human preference for response y to prompt x.

Therefore the learned reward may reflect

  • annotator preferences and disagreements,
  • biases toward particular styles or levels of detail,
  • incomplete coverage of possible prompts and behaviors.

The learned reward is a proxy for the behavior we actually want.

奖励模型给一个 (提示, 回答) 对打一个实数分 rθ​(x,y), 分数越高应当对应人越偏好的回答. InstructGPT 的奖励模型从人对模型输出的排序中训练; 结构和 SFT 模型相同 (把语言模型头换成一个输出标量的头), 但小得多: 策略是 1750 亿参数时, 奖励模型只用 60 亿.

训练目标: 标注员偏好 yw​ 胜过 yl​ 时, 希望 r(x,yw​)>r(x,yl​). 损失是 −logσ(rw​−rl​): 这就是 Bradley–Terry 模型 (第 13 章), 把「yw​ 胜出的概率」建模为 σ(rw​−rl​), 再做最大似然. 分差越大, σ 越接近 1, 损失越接近 0; 排反了损失很大. 一次排序 K 个回答可以得到 (2K​) 个两两比较 (K = 4 时 6 个, K = 9 时 36 个); 除以 (2K​) 是为了让每个提示的权重相同, 不因为排序的回答多就占比大.

奖励模型并不直接学到真实、安全或有用, 它学的是预测训练数据里的偏好. 所以学到的奖励可能反映标注员的偏好和分歧、对某种风格或详略程度的偏向、对可能的提示和行为覆盖不全. 学到的奖励只是我们真正想要的行为的代理 (proxy).

幻灯片排版问题: Slide 18 底部残留了一份奖励模型损失公式 (就是 Slide 19 的公式), 与本页内容无关, 像是改版时没删干净.

从奖励模型到强化学习; RLHF 目标
From reward model to reinforcement learning · The RLHF objective · How to read the RLHF objective

Slide 21–23

Now keep the trained reward model rθ​ fixed and optimize the language model.

prompt → token → token → ⋯ → response → reward

  • πϕRL​: language model being optimized.
  • Given a prompt x, it samples a response y∼πϕRL​(⋅∣x).
  • The fixed reward model assigns rθ​(x,y).
  • PPO updates ϕ so that high-reward responses become more likely to be generated.

Key difference from reward-model training: the training responses are generated by the model being optimized.

In InstructGPT, PPO optimizes the policy parameters ϕ:

objective(ϕ)=E(x,y)∼DπϕRL​​​[rθ​(x,y)−βlog(πSFT(y∣x)πϕRL​(y∣x)​)].
  • πϕRL​: current policy; ϕ is optimized.
  • πSFT: fixed SFT reference model.
  • rθ​: fixed trained reward model.
  • DπϕRL​​: prompt–response samples generated under the current policy.

Unlike supervised learning, the sample distribution itself changes as ϕ changes. Ouyang et al., 2022

(How to read: rθ​(x,y) = high reward; −βlogπSFT(y∣x)πϕRL​(y∣x)​ = stay close to SFT.)

The expectation means: approximately average over a batch sampled from the current RL policy:

E(x,y)∼DπϕRL​​​[f(x,y)]≈N1​i=1∑N​f(xi​,yi​),yi​∼πϕRL​(⋅∣xi​).
  • High reward encourages the policy to generate preferred responses.
  • The log-ratio penalizes moving too far from the SFT model.

把训练好的奖励模型固定住, 优化语言模型 (称为策略 πϕRL​): 给定提示, 策略逐词元采样出一个回答, 固定的奖励模型打分, PPO 更新 ϕ, 让高奖励的回答更可能被生成. 和训练奖励模型的关键区别: 训练用的回答是由正在被优化的模型自己生成的.

目标函数 = 奖励 − β × 策略和 SFT 模型之间的对数比. 第一项鼓励生成受偏好的回答; 第二项惩罚离 SFT 模型太远 (它的期望就是 KL 散度 KL(πRL∥πSFT)). 为什么需要这一项: 奖励模型只在 SFT 模型会生成的那类回答上训练过, 策略一旦跑到很陌生的区域, 奖励模型的分数就不可信了, 策略会找到奖励模型的漏洞 (见 Slide 34 的奖励投机). 期望是对当前策略采样出的一批回答求平均; 和有监督学习不同, 样本分布本身随 ϕ 变化, 这是强化学习难训练的原因之一.

PPO-ptx; PPO 比 SFT 好多少
PPO-ptx: preserve pretraining capabilities · Does PPO improve over SFT?

Slide 24–25

InstructGPT also mixes pretraining gradients into PPO:

objective(ϕ)=E(x,y)∼DπϕRL​​​[rθ​(x,y)−βlog(πSFT(y∣x)πϕRL​(y∣x)​)]+γEx∼Dpretrain​​[logπϕRL​(x)].
  • First line: high reward while staying close to SFT.
  • Second line: keep assigning high likelihood to pretraining text.
  • For plain PPO, γ=0.
  • With γ>0, the paper calls the model PPO-ptx.

Ouyang et al., 2022

In the main InstructGPT human evaluation, PPO-based models were preferred over SFT.

  • PPO win rate over SFT is roughly 0.6: clearly above chance-level 0.5.
  • The improvement is meaningful, but not dramatic.
  • PPO-ptx also reduces regression on pretraining benchmarks.

Can one achieve similar gains with a simpler preference-optimization method?

InstructGPT 还在 PPO 里混入预训练的梯度: 目标多一项 γ × 预训练文本的对数似然, 让模型继续给预训练文本高概率. 原因是只做 RLHF 时, 模型在一些公开 NLP 基准上会退步 (所谓「对齐税」), 混入预训练目标可以减轻. γ = 0 是普通 PPO, γ > 0 论文称为 PPO-ptx.

读图: 纵轴是对 175B SFT 模型的胜率 (人评比较), 横轴是模型大小 (1.3B、6B、175B). PPO-ptx (红) 和 PPO (橙) 在所有大小上都最高, 175B 时约 0.6–0.65; SFT 自己 (绿) 175B 时正好 0.5; 加了提示的 GPT-3 (浅蓝) 和原始 GPT-3 (深蓝) 低得多. 而且 1.3B 的 PPO 模型已经胜过 175B 的 SFT (约 0.52) 和远胜 175B 的 GPT-3. 改进有意义但不算惊人; PPO-ptx 还减少了在预训练基准上的退步. 能不能用更简单的方法得到类似的提升? 这引出 DPO.

直接偏好优化 (DPO)
Can we optimize preferences directly? · The DPO objective · How to read the DPO objective

Slide 27–29

Standard RLHF uses two separate optimization stages: human preferences ⟶ reward model ⟶ RL / PPO.

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO): Optimize the language model directly from the preference pairs Rafailov et al., 2023: Direct Preference Optimization

  • No separately trained reward model.
  • No sampling from the policy inside an RL training loop.
  • Train directly on a fixed preference dataset.

Training data are preference triples (x,yw​,yl​), where yw​ is the winning and yl​ the lower-ranked response. DPO minimizes

LDPO​(θ)=−E(x,yw​,yl​)∼D​[logσ(βlogπref​(yw​∣x)πθ​(yw​∣x)​−βlogπref​(yl​∣x)πθ​(yl​∣x)​)].
  • πθ​: policy being optimized.
  • πref​: fixed reference policy, typically the SFT model.
  • β: inverse-temperature parameter; scales the effect of a given preference margin.
  • D: fixed dataset of preference comparisons.

Rafailov et al., 2023

Consider logπref​(y∣x)πθ​(y∣x)​. It measures how much the new policy has changed the likelihood of response y relative to the reference model. The DPO loss compares this change for the two responses:

preferred responselogπref​(yw​∣x)πθ​(yw​∣x)​​​−rejected responselogπref​(yl​∣x)πθ​(yl​∣x)​​​.
  • Make the preferred response relatively more likely.
  • Make the rejected response relatively less likely.
  • Measure both changes relative to the fixed reference policy.

标准 RLHF 有两个分开的优化阶段: 用偏好训练奖励模型, 再用强化学习优化策略. DPO (Rafailov et al. 2023) 直接从偏好对优化语言模型: 不单独训练奖励模型, 训练中不需要从策略采样, 直接在固定的偏好数据集上训练, 就像普通的有监督学习. 读图: 左边 RLHF: 偏好数据 → 用最大似然训练奖励模型 → 强化学习循环 (策略采样回答, 奖励模型打分) → 最终语言模型; 右边 DPO: 偏好数据直接用最大似然得到最终语言模型.

DPO 的损失: 对每个三元组, 先算两个回答各自的对数比 logπθ​/πref​, 即新策略相对参考模型 (通常是 SFT 模型) 把这个回答的概率提高了多少; 然后要求「好回答的提高量」比「差回答的提高量」大, 差值乘 β 后过 sigmoid 取负对数. 效果: 好回答相对更可能, 差回答相对更不可能, 两者都相对于固定的参考策略来衡量. β 越大, 同样的概率差带来的影响越大, 也相当于更强地约束策略不离参考模型太远 (对应 RLHF 目标里的 β).

易错: DPO 不是要把好回答的概率推到 1: 它只关心相对于参考模型的变化之差. 实践中常见好、差回答的概率同时下降, 只要差回答降得更多, 损失照样下降.

为什么 DPO 可以不要奖励模型; 效果如何
Why can DPO eliminate the reward model? · Does DPO work?

Slide 30–31

For KL-regularized (w.r.t. the reference policy) RLHF, Rafailov et al., 2023

r(x,y)=βlogπref​(y∣x)π∗(y∣x)​+c(x).

DPO reverses this relation: Each candidate policy defines the reward for which it would be optimal.

Thus, for a preference pair,

rθ​(x,yw​)−rθ​(x,yl​)=β[logπref​(yw​∣x)πθ​(yw​∣x)​−logπref​(yl​∣x)πθ​(yl​∣x)​],

because the prompt-dependent constant cancels.

  • DPO matches or outperforms PPO in the experiments in the original paper.
  • On TL;DR summarization: about 61% win rate for DPO vs. about 57% for PPO at their best reported settings.
  • DPO achieves this without a separate reward model or an RL training loop.

推导的关键: 对带 KL 正则的 RLHF 目标 (Slide 22), 最优策略有闭式解 π∗(y∣x)=Z(x)1​πref​(y∣x)exp(r(x,y)/β). 两边取对数再整理, 奖励就可以用最优策略表示: r(x,y)=βlogπref​π∗​+βlogZ(x), 其中 c(x)=βlogZ(x) 只和提示有关. DPO 把这个关系反过来用: 每个候选策略都隐含着一个「它在其下最优」的奖励. 把这个隐含奖励代入奖励模型的 Bradley–Terry 损失 (Slide 19), 对同一个提示的两个回答相减, 难算的 c(x) (要对所有可能的回答求和) 正好消掉, 就得到 DPO 的损失. 所以 DPO 是在直接训练策略的同时隐式地拟合了奖励模型.

读图: TL;DR 摘要任务, 纵轴是 GPT-4 判断的对参考摘要的胜率, 横轴是采样温度. DPO (黄) 在温度 0 时约 0.61, 最高; PPO (粉) 最好约 0.57 (温度 0), 温度升高后急剧下降; DPO 对温度更稳. DPO 在原论文的实验里与 PPO 相当或更好, 而且不用奖励模型和强化学习循环.

对齐的权衡: 过度拒答、奖励投机、多目标
Safety training can over-refuse · Reward hacking: optimizing the proxy · Alignment is multi-objective

Slide 33–35

Safety training should reduce harmful responses, but too much caution can make the model less useful.

User:  Are Hindus allowed to travel by sea?
Model: I'm sorry, I cannot complete your request. The user query is a question about a
       broad topic. I cannot give you any info about that, as I am a language model, not a
       general purpose question answering system.

Alignment requires a trade-off between helpfulness and harmlessness.

  • Too permissive → harmful responses.
  • Too cautious → harmless requests are refused.

The reward model is only a proxy for the behavior we actually want.

desired behavior ⟶ human preferences ⟶ learned reward

Example: hallucination — A response may be: fluent + confident + helpful-looking + wrong yet still receive high reward if the reward model has learned to value the first three properties strongly.

high learned reward ⇏ high true quality.

Optimizing a proxy can amplify its mistakes.

What counts as a “good” response is not a single objective.

helpful · truthful · harmless · uncertain when appropriate

These goals can conflict, so post-training implicitly chooses trade-offs between them.

  • Preferences depend on annotators and their instructions.
  • Different users and cultures may prefer different behavior.
  • There is therefore no completely value-neutral alignment target.

Alignment is not only an optimization problem: it also specifies whose preferences the model should follow.

过度拒答: 安全训练应当减少有害回答, 但太谨慎会让模型没用. 例子: 用户问「印度教徒可以乘船出海吗?」(一个关于宗教习俗的普通问题), 模型却拒绝回答, 说自己「是语言模型, 不是通用问答系统」. 对齐需要在有帮助和无害之间权衡: 太宽松会产生有害回答, 太谨慎会拒绝无害的请求.

奖励投机 (reward hacking): 奖励模型只是代理, 中间隔了两层 (期望行为 → 人的偏好 → 学到的奖励). 例: 幻觉. 一个回答流畅、自信、看起来有帮助, 但却是错的, 如果奖励模型很看重前三个性质, 它照样得高分. 学到的奖励高不等于真实质量高; 对代理做优化会放大代理的错误 (Goodhart 定律: 一个指标一旦成为优化目标, 就不再是好指标).

多目标: 好回答不是单一目标: 有帮助、真实、无害、在该不确定时表达不确定. 这些目标会冲突, 后训练隐含地在它们之间做取舍. 偏好取决于标注员和给他们的指示; 不同用户和文化偏好不同的行为; 因此不存在完全价值中立的对齐目标. 对齐不只是优化问题, 还要规定模型应当听从谁的偏好.

思维链: 原始想法与现在的含义
Chain-of-thought: the original idea · prompting vs. training

Slide 37–38

Standard prompting often struggles on tasks that require multi-step reasoning. Chain-of-thought prompting adds intermediate reasoning steps: input ⟶ reasoning steps ⟶ answer.

  • Originally introduced as a form of few-shot prompting.
  • Demonstrations contain a reasoning trace and the final answer.

The term “chain-of-thought” is now used more broadly.

  • Original CoT few-shot prompting: reasoning examples are provided in the prompt.
  • “Think step by step” without examples is not few-shot chain-of-thought prompting.
  • Modern reasoning models can instead be trained to generate reasoning traces.

Reasoning traces need not come from examples in the prompt.

标准提示在需要多步推理的任务上常常失败. 思维链 (CoT) 提示在输入和答案之间加上中间推理步骤. 读图: 示范题「Roger 有 5 个网球, 又买了 2 罐, 每罐 3 个, 现在有几个?」. 左边示范只给答案 11, 模型对新题「食堂有 23 个苹果, 用 20 个做午饭, 又买了 6 个, 还剩几个?」答 27, 错; 右边示范写出推理「5 + 2 × 3 = 11」, 模型也写出推理「23 − 20 = 3, 3 + 6 = 9」, 答 9, 对. 思维链最初是一种少样本提示: 示范里包含推理过程和最终答案.

现在「思维链」一词用得更宽. 原始的 CoT 少样本提示: 推理示例放在提示里; 不给例子、只说「一步一步想」(Kojima et al. 2022 的零样本 CoT) 就不算少样本思维链提示; 现代推理模型则是被训练成会生成推理过程. 推理过程不必来自提示里的例子.

把推理作为后训练
Reasoning as post-training · Reasoning enables verifiable rewards · What can reasoning training change?

Slide 39–41

Modern reasoning models use post-training to make reasoning behavior part of the policy itself.

  • Supervised fine-tuning on reasoning examples.
  • Reinforcement learning on generated reasoning trajectories.
  • The model can produce a potentially long reasoning trace before giving the final answer.
Query: The denominator of a fraction is 7 less than 3 times the numerator.
       If the fraction is equivalent to 2/5, what is the numerator?
Correct reasoning trace
Step 1  Let the numerator be x.
Step 2  The denominator is 3x-7.
Step 3  We know that x/(3x-7) = 2/5.
Step 4  Therefore, 5x = 6x-14.
Step 5  Finally, we get x= 14. (Correct)

Reasoning becomes learned behavior, not just a prompting trick. DeepSeek-AI, 2025

For some tasks, correctness can be checked automatically.

  • Mathematics: compare the final answer with a known correct answer.
  • Code: compile and run generated programs against test cases.
PROMPT
Let b ≥ 2 be an integer. Call a positive integer n b-eautiful if it has exactly two digits when expressed
in base b, and these two digits sum to √n. For example, 81 is 13-eautiful because 81 = 6 3 (base 13) and
6 + 3 = √81. Find the least integer b ≥ 2 for which there are more than ten b-eautiful integers.
Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.
Evaluation
Parse the final answer within \boxed{} and use a rule-based grader to determine if it equals the
ground truth. Round numerical values as needed, and use 'SymPy' to parse expressions.

The reward can come from an automatic verifier instead of human preferences. DeepSeek-AI, 2025

During reasoning training, models can learn behaviors such as

  • trying alternative strategies,
  • self-verification and checking,
  • reflection and correction,
  • backtracking,
  • producing longer reasoning traces for harder problems.

现代推理模型用后训练把推理行为变成策略本身的一部分: 在推理示例上做 SFT; 对模型生成的推理轨迹做强化学习; 模型可以在给出最终答案前先产生可能很长的推理过程. 例子 (分数题): 设分子 x, 分母 3x − 7, x/(3x−7)=2/5, 所以 5x=6x−14, x = 14 (验算: 14/35 = 2/5 ✓). 推理成了学到的行为, 而不只是提示技巧.

有些任务的正确性可以自动验证: 数学题比较最终答案和标准答案; 代码编译后跑测试用例. 于是奖励可以来自自动验证器而不是人的偏好, 也就不用训练奖励模型, 避免了奖励投机的一大来源. 例题 (AIME 2024): 称 n 为「b-美丽数」, 如果 n 在 b 进制下恰好两位, 且两位数字之和等于 n​; 例如 81 在 13 进制下是 (6, 3), 6 + 3 = 9 = √81. 求使 b-美丽数超过 10 个的最小 b. 评分: 取出 \boxed{} 里的答案, 用规则判分器和标准答案比较. 我用 Python 枚举, 答案是 b = 211 (此时恰有 15 个).

推理训练中模型可能学会: 尝试其他策略、自我验证和检查、反思和纠正、回溯、对更难的问题写更长的推理. 读图: 左边是 DeepSeek-R1-Zero 解一道方程题时, 中途自己写下「Wait, wait. That's an aha moment I can flag here.」然后回头一步步重新检查 (红字); 右边是训练过程中「wait」「mistake」「verify」这类反思词出现的频率, 随训练步数从几千上升到一万以上. 这些行为没有人教, 是强化学习中自发出现的.

推理过程不一定忠实
A plausible reasoning trace · Reasoning traces are not necessarily faithful

Slide 42–43

The model answers correctly and then explains its answer with a familiar step-by-step algorithm.

Human: Answer in one word. What is 36+59?

Assistant: 95

Human: Briefly, how did you get that?

Assistant: I added the ones (6+9=15), carried the 1, then added the tens
(3+5+1=9), resulting in 95.

But did the model actually compute the answer this way?

Interpretability analysis suggests that the internal computation can differ substantially from the verbalized algorithm. Anthropic, 2025

模型正确回答 36 + 59 = 95, 被问到怎么算的, 它说出一个熟悉的竖式算法: 个位 6 + 9 = 15, 进 1, 十位 3 + 5 + 1 = 9, 得 95. 但模型真的是这样算的吗? 读图: Anthropic 2025 年对 Claude 3.5 Haiku 的可解释性分析 (归因图, 第 14 章讲这类方法) 显示, 内部计算分两条并行的路径: 一条做粗略的数量级估计 (「大约 36 + 60」, 和约 92), 另一条用类似查表的特征精确算出个位 (「6 + 9 结尾是 5」); 两条合在一起得到 95. 内部根本没有「进位」这一步. 模型口头给出的解释是从训练数据里学来的、人类会这么写的解释, 而不是它真实的计算过程. 推理过程看起来合理不等于忠实 (见第 14 章).

后训练要点小结
Post-training: main takeaways

Slide 44

Pretrained LM ⟶ SFT ⟶ Preference Optimization

  • SFT: train on desired instruction–response pairs.
  • Reward model: train on human preference comparisons between responses.
  • PPO / RLHF: optimize a policy that generates high-reward responses while staying close to the SFT reference model.
  • DPO: optimize the policy directly from preference pairs, without fitting a separate reward model or running an RL loop.
  • Alignment has trade-offs: imperfect objectives can cause reward hacking and over-refusal.
  • Reasoning can be post-trained: verifiable feedback can encourage checking, reflection, and backtracking.

要点: SFT 用期望的指令–回答对训练; 奖励模型用人对回答的两两比较训练; PPO/RLHF 优化策略, 让它生成高奖励的回答, 同时不离 SFT 参考模型太远; DPO 直接从偏好对优化策略, 不拟合单独的奖励模型, 也不跑强化学习循环; 对齐有权衡, 不完美的目标会导致奖励投机和过度拒答; 推理可以通过后训练获得, 可验证的反馈能鼓励检查、反思和回溯.

11.2 训练 LLM (旧版课件): 新版里没有的内容
Training LLMs: Memory and compute requirements · How to reduce compute and memory · Scaling laws (slides-111, 112, 113)

GitHub 第 11 章 (training-llms) 里除了已在第 9 章做过笔记的 9compute、9fast、9scale, 还有 slides-111、112、113 三份. 按 PDF 的生成日期, 它们是那三份的旧版 (111、113 生成于 2026 年 1 月, 112 生成于 2025 年 11 月; 9compute、9fast、9scale 生成于 2026 年 7–9 月), 大部分页面逐字相同. 这里只记旧版独有的内容, 其余页面见 9.7 节、9.8 节、9.6 节, 以及第 10 章的重写版.

slides-111: 参数量与数据量的经验法则
Parameters vs dataset

slides-111 · Slide 6
  • Model performance depends on number of parameters P, but also on number of training tokens D
  • One proposed optimal tradeoff between P and D is: D = 20P
    • This was true for Chinchilla models Hoffmann et al., 2022, not clear to what extent it still holds.
  • Training an LLM on less than 200 billion tokens is not recommended
  • One rule of thumb: First determine the uppermost inference cost, and then train the biggest model within that boundary
  • Different ways to determine P: based on available data, compute budget or inference time

旧版和 9.7 节 Slide 6 的区别: 旧版说「D = 20P 对 Chinchilla 成立, 不清楚现在还成立多少」, 新版改成「已不再被视为有效」; 旧版给了一条新版删掉的经验法则: 先确定能接受的最高推理成本, 再在这个范围内训练尽可能大的模型, 以及「训练词元少于 2000 亿不建议」. 这条经验法则和 10.2 节最后说的「为了降低推理成本, 把小模型训练得远超算力最优」是同一个思路.

旧版的数字表示和 INT8 量化两页 (Slide 9、11) 与新版只差措辞; 新版另外增加了绝对最大值量化和零点量化的图例和推导 (9.7 节 Slide 12–15).

slides-112: FlashAttention 的速度和三个技巧
FlashAttention · Computing considerations · Limitations and prospects

slides-112 · Slide 1, 7, 10, 12

(Titelseite: nur der Text „RESTORE LECTURE COMMAND“.)

FlashAttention Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness

  • Fast
    • 15 % faster than BERT
    • 3x faster than GPT-2
    • 2.4x faster than Megatron-LM
  • Memory-efficient
    • Reducing from O(n2) to O(n)
  • Exact
    • Same as “vanilla attention”, not an approximation
  • IO aware
    • Reducing memory load/store operations

Computing considerations

  • GPU compute has been growing faster than memory bandwidth
    • GPU has to wait for data
  • Transformer operations are memory-bound
    • Elementwise operations with high memory access
  • IO aware means reducing memory load/store operations
  • FlashAttention implements the following:
    • Operation fusion to reduce memory access
    • Tiling or chunking the softmax matrix into blocks
    • Recomputation for better memory utilization

Limitations and prospects

  • FlashAttention requires writing attention to CUDA language
    • A new CUDA kernel for each new attention implementation
    • CUDA is lower-level than PyTorch
    • Implementation may not be transferable accross GPUs
  • Towards IO-Aware Deep Learning
    • Extending beyonde attention
  • Multi-GPU IO-Aware Methods
    • FlashAttention computation may be parallelizable accross multiple GPUs

旧版独有的内容: FlashAttention 的速度数字; 「GPU 的计算能力增长快于显存带宽」(所以等数据的问题越来越严重); 把 FlashAttention 概括成三个技巧: 算子融合 (减少访存)、分块 (把 softmax 矩阵切成块)、重计算 (反向时重新算注意力块而不是存下来, 见 10.3 节 Slide 10); 前景里多了「多 GPU 的 IO 感知方法: FlashAttention 的计算可以在多块 GPU 上并行」.

幻灯片错误: 「15 % faster than BERT, 3x faster than GPT-2, 2.4x faster than Megatron-LM」把论文的结论说错了. FlashAttention 论文 (Dao et al. 2022) 的摘要是: 训练 BERT-large (序列长 512) 比 MLPerf 1.1 的训练速度纪录快 15%; 训练 GPT-2 (序列长 1K) 比 HuggingFace 的实现快 3 倍 (比 Megatron-LM 快 1.7 倍); 在 long-range arena (序列长 1K–4K) 上快 2.4 倍. 「比 BERT 快」「比 GPT-2 快」也说不通: BERT、GPT-2 是模型, 比较的是同一个模型用不同注意力实现的训练速度.

幻灯片排版问题: 标题页只显示「RESTORE LECTURE COMMAND」, 是 LaTeX 里讲座标题的命令没有定义, 直接输出了占位文字; 页脚的页码印成「1 / 11」……「12 / 11」, 当前页超过了总页数 (共 12 页); 页脚标题是「Training Large Language Models」, 和课程其他课件的「Deep Learning for NLP」不同. 原文笔误: 「parallellism」「accross」(三处)、「beyonde」. Slide 4 的「Gradient Aggregation」只写了「梯度在各节点本地计算」, 缺了新版里「然后在节点之间求平均」这关键的一步.

slides-113: 最优批大小
Scaling laws proposed by Kaplan et al. · Optimal batch size · Compute-optimal LLMs (2)

slides-113 · Slide 3, 6–8, 13

(Slide 3, additional point) Sample efficiency: Large models are more sample-efficient than small models; They reach same performance with fewer optimization steps

Optimal batch size

  • Claim: “Optimal batch size: The ideal batch size for training these models is roughly a power of the loss only, and continues to be determinable by measuring the gradient noise scale [MKAT18]; it is roughly 1-2 million tokens at convergence for the largest models we can train.”
  • gradient noise scale = a measure of the signal-to-noise ratio of gradient across training examples

The ideal batch size increases over the course of training.

  • Estimate gradient as accurately as possible → large batch
  • Exploit stochasticity (epoch batches would not be a good thing even if we could compute them efficiently) → small batch
  • Increase training speed as much as possible → large step size
  • Based on the estimated gradient, choose a step size such that the cost of the landing position does not deviate too much from the cost of the ideal landing position → small step size

(Slide 13, longer quotation from Hoffmann et al.:) “… Based on our estimated compute-optimal frontier, we predict that for the compute budget used to train Gopher, an optimal model should be 4 times smaller, while being training on 4 times more tokens. We verify this by training a more compute-optimal 70B model, called Chinchilla, on 1.4 trillion tokens. … The energy cost of a large language model is amortized through its usage for inference and fine-tuning. The benefits of a more optimally trained smaller model, therefore, extend beyond the immediate benefits of its improved performance.”

旧版独有的内容: Kaplan 的结论里多了一条样本效率: 大模型更省样本, 用更少的优化步数达到同样的表现. 两页最优批大小: Kaplan 声称理想的批大小大致只是损失的幂函数, 可以通过测量梯度噪声尺度 (gradient noise scale, McCandlish et al. 2018, 即 [MKAT18]: 各样本梯度之间的信噪比) 确定, 对他们能训练的最大模型, 收敛时约 100–200 万个词元.

读图: 左: 二次损失的等高线, 黑点是当前位置. 小批次 (红) 估计的梯度方向噪声大, 如果用大步长就会越过谷底 (红叉), 训练不稳; 大批次 (蓝) 的梯度更接近真实梯度, 可以用更大的步长, 每步前进更多. 右: 训练速度随「批大小 / 噪声尺度 B」的变化 (对数坐标): 批大小远小于 B 时, 批大小加倍训练就快一倍 (完美扩展); 超过 B 后再加大批次几乎不再加速 (无效扩展), 转折点处速度是最大值的 50%.

批大小的四点权衡: 想尽量准确地估计梯度 → 大批次; 想利用随机性 (即使能高效算出整个 epoch 的梯度也不是好事, 噪声有助于跳出坏的区域、改善泛化) → 小批次; 想尽量快 → 大步长; 但要让落点的损失不比理想落点差太多 → 小步长. 训练过程中损失下降、梯度信噪比变低, 理想批大小随之增大, 所以大模型训练常常逐步加大批次 (batch size warmup).

Chinchilla 引文比新版多了两句: 按他们估计的算力最优前沿, 用 Gopher 的预算, 最优模型应小 4 倍、训练词元多 4 倍; 大模型的能耗会分摊到推理和微调的使用中, 所以一个训练更充分的小模型的好处不止于它本身的性能.

113 的其余页面和 9.6 节相同; 新版另外加了「上下文利用的规模定律 (NoLiMa)」和黄仁勋谈规模化两页.

原文笔误: 引文里「while being training on 4 times more tokens」是原论文的语法错误, 应为 being trained (课件照录).
